description: Cron entry: load queue, pick highest-priority action, dispatch, persist state, exit.
Sync GitHub state into the queue: new PRs, new comments, archive closed, flag idle.
Classify a PR or comment. PR mode: actionable / definite-no / possible-duplicate / needs-review. Comment mode: actionable / advisory / noise.
Find PRs touching same files; classify pairs as independent / conflicting / complementary / redundant.
Full code review with structured findings (file:line + severity + suggested_fix). Optional Comment-type GitHub review.
Reproduce alleged bug in a sandboxed PR-branch worktree. Verdict: verified / not-verified / ambiguous.
Design fix with failing-test-first contract. Run test (FAIL) -> apply fix -> confirm PASS + no regressions.
Skeptic gate before any implementation. Six-item checklist + regression suite + auto-reject on any regression.
Push fix branch and open PR into contributor's branch (Tier 2 trust ramp). Fallback to fenced-diff comment on PR-create failure.
Final PR call: ready-to-merge / request-changes / close-as-not-now. Close-as-not-now never auto-closes the PR; labels only.
Aggregate state + per-PR caches; send daily HTML email at prj_report_hour_local. All-quiet semantics: brief liveness email when nothing changed.
